text: {"edits": [], "notes": "No edits proposed. The current file already uses `MyPermissionsScopes.model_validate(...)` at the only flagged site, so the original deprecated-method finding (`parse_obj` -> `model_validate`) is resolved and should be kept. I checked the rest of the file for other v1 APIs (`dict()`, `json()`, `parse_raw`, `parse_file`, `from_orm`, `copy()`, `construct()`, `__fields__`, `update_forward_refs`, `validator`/`root_validator`, `validate_arguments`) and found none.\n\nThe reported failure is not caused by this file. The traceback is a `keycloak.exceptions.KeycloakConnectionError` from `test_teams_client_no_connection_proxy`: urllib3 cannot connect to localhost:35789 (connection refused) when requesting a Keycloak token. Nothing in resources/my_permissions.py touches that path, and the test is in the teams client proxy suite. This looks like an environment issue (no Keycloak/proxy listening on that port during the test run) or a test that expects a connection failure to be handled differently. It is not a Pydantic v1-to-v2 migration issue, so a file edit here would not fix it. The test should be investigated in the teams client code or test fixtures, or the test environment should be checked, rather than this file."}
